description: Load-following HTGR (helium-cooled, pebble-bed or prismatic) with Xe-135 dynamics and large graphite thermal mass inertia. Graphite moderator has a very large heat capacity which slows power transients and provides thermal stability.

unit.name: Generic 250 MWth / 100 MWe Pebble Bed HTGR (PBMR/HTR-PM class)
unit.source: Dong (2011) Nucl. Eng. Des. 241:4755-4762; Zhang et al. (2009) Nucl. Eng. Des. 239:2265-2274 (HTR-PM); Muto et al. (2003) IAEA-TECDOC-1318 (GTHTR300); Reitsma (2004) IAEA TRS-424.

P_thermal_mw.note: Thermal power at full load (HTR-PM module: 250 MWth)

eta_thermal.note: Net efficiency; HTGR drives Brayton cycle at 750-950C -> ~42-45% possible; use 42%

sigma_Xe_cm2.note: Xe-135 microscopic absorption cross-section (thermal spectrum reactor)

gamma_I.note: I-135 cumulative fission yield (same for thermal U-235 fission)

ramp_rate_limit_pct_min.note: HTGR has moderate ramp capability; helium has low thermal inertia but graphite moderator slows fuel temperature changes; ~7%/min typical for pebble-bed design

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable power for pebble-bed design (40%); helium circulators and cycle efficiency degrade below this

total_reactivity_margin_pcm.note: HTGR uses control rods plus reflector control; high margin for graphite-moderated design

xenon_reactivity_coeff_pcm.note: Xe worth in graphite-moderated thermal reactor (slightly lower than PWR due to harder thermal spectrum in graphite)

graphite_thermal_mass_mj_per_k.note: Total graphite moderator heat capacity (250 MWth core: ~1400 tonnes graphite, cp~0.2 kJ/kgK -> 280 MJ/K); large thermal inertia slows power transients

temp_coeff_pcm_per_K.note: Combined fuel+moderator temperature reactivity coefficient; strongly negative in TRISO-fueled HTGR (Doppler + graphite neutron spectrum shift)

T_helium_inlet_C.note: Helium inlet temperature at rated power

T_helium_outlet_C.note: Helium outlet temperature at rated power
